description: This file defines interfaces, proxy, and stub classes for COM-like object management, including UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and UnknownProxyType, within the Thunder namespace. It manages remote interface proxies, stub handling, and communication mechanisms.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations, providing interface ID, conversion, and handle methods.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub, representing specific interface stubs with method handlers.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing remote interface references, reference counting, and communication.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class wrapping UnknownProxy to implement specific interface proxies.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size of the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to a Core::IUnknown pointer.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on index.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, managing reference counts.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and handles cleanup.

methods.name: RemoteInterface
methods.description: Requests remote interface by ID.

methods.name: Parent
methods.description: Returns the parent IUnknown object.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Gets interface pointer for given implementation and ID.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID.

methods.name: Implementation
methods.description: Returns the implementation ID.

methods.name: ChannelId
methods.description: Returns the channel ID.

methods.name: Channel
methods.description: Returns the IPC channel proxy.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for a specific method ID.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message with optional wait time.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes proxy operation, handling reference release and cleanup.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the proxy.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for specific interface by ID.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the link ID.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the proxy, releasing channel.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the proxy.
